name: Ben Holland Young
tagline: PhD Researcher in Statistics and Probability, University of Bath
description: Ben Holland Young is a PhD researcher in statistics and probability at the University of Bath, developing statistical tools for non-stationary time series. Seeking quantitative research and machine learning internships.

intro.summary: I am a second-year PhD researcher in the SAMBa Centre for Doctoral Training at the University of Bath. My research develops statistical tools for analysing non-stationary time series, where standard stationary methods give misleading answers. I began my PhD in near-critical percolation and branching processes before switching to time series. Through the CDT I have delivered week-long and three-month modelling projects in Python with external partners in healthcare, sport and biology, from problem formulation through to report and presentation.
intro.seeking: I am looking for quantitative research and machine learning internships.
intro.rightToWork: I have the right to work in the UK and EU.

education.phd: PhD Mathematics (Statistics and Probability), University of Bath, October 2025 to present. EPSRC-funded, SAMBa Centre for Doctoral Training. Expected completion: November 2029.
education.cdt: Training in advanced probability, statistics, machine learning, numerical analysis and mathematical modelling, including 91% in Numerical Solution of Evolutionary Equations.
education.mmath: MMath Mathematics, First Class Honours (79%), University of Bath, 2020 to 2025.
